speaker: Patient
text: 3-year-old child. The parents report that the child appears unwell and has been breathing rapidly. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure (likely due to Dilated Cardiomyopathy).

The symptoms of rapid breathing, leg swelling, liver enlargement, and fatigue in a 3-year-old without fever or respiratory infection strongly suggest fluid overload from heart failure. I need to confirm this with an Echocardiogram to assess heart structure and function.
